about_the_game:
Overview:

You and your friends are hired as Liquidators—a crew meant to transform a wasteland back into its pristine state. Before you are allowed to enter the open-world radioactive wilderness (the early access game), you’ll need to complete the onboarding process and prove your grit.

What's in it:

- Complete training and full onboarding process to prove your worth in WEA-001 Control Point.

- See what it's like being a WEA Liquidator with most of the major mechanics from the full game available.

- Take a glance at the radioactive wilderness—your future work site.

- Stay alert: something dangerous happened at WEA-001 Control Point, and you might be asked to help…

- Proximity-based voice communication is ready for real-time strategizing with your team.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060, 3 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700K
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1080 TI, 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space

short_description: You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, complete your training in this free co-op survival horror FPS demo and master core mechanics. Learn to work along radiation, handle weapons and essential tools, and discover what the future cleanup of a dangerous, radioactive wilderness looks like.
